titles.title: Fair Pricing for Prescription Drugs Act

A bill to amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act with respect to the importation of prescription drugs and to amend part D of title XVIII of the Social Security Act to require the Secretary of Health and Human Services to negotiate covered part D drug prices on behalf of Medicare beneficiaries.
Fair Pricing for Prescription Drugs Act
Pharmaceutical Market Access and Drug Safety Act of 2010
